status.en: 23 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 21% more than the week before, most of them in Darfur, Khartoum and Kordofan.
status.nb: 23 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 21 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Darfur, Khartoum og Kordofan.

summary.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces have seized Al-Khuwai and five other sites in West Kordofan and are pushing toward Al-Nahud while reinforcing the Blue Nile front, increasing pressure on the Rapid Support Forces. The RSF continues to conduct drone strikes on civilian populations and power stations, causing darkness and civilian casualties, including children. A Rapid Support Forces field commander defected to the SAF and a former RSF adviser was released in Chad, while a former Sudanese information minister was attacked in Uganda. A former Sudanese official wanted by the ICC was arrested, confirming U.S. involvement. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den sudanske hæren (SAF) har tatt kontroll over Al-Khuwai og fem andre steder i Vest-Kordofan og presser mot Al-Nahud mens den forsterker fronten i Blå Nilen, noe som øker presset på RSF-militsen. RSF-militsen fortsetter å gjennomføre droneangrep mot sivilbefolkning og kraftstasjoner, noe som forårsaker mørke og sivile tap, inkludert barn. En felthøvding i RSF-militsen har gått over til SAF, og en tidligere rådgiver for RSF ble løslatt i Tsjad, mens en tidligere sudansk informasjonsminister ble angrepet i Uganda. En tidligere sudansk tjenestemann som er etterlyst av ICC ble arrestert, noe som bekrefter amerikansk involvering. 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
